source_refs.note: Exercise 4.2, Question 3: Show that: ten determinant identities, parts (i)-(x) (book pages 59-60).

blocks.explanation:
Yahan do number wale determinants ka rishta dikhana hai: left wala right wale ka 25 guna hai.
25 kahan se aayega? \(5 \times 5\). Column 2 (\(5, 25, 25\)) mein 5 common hai, aur us ke baad row 2 mein bhi 5 common ho jata hai.
Plan: pehle \(C_2\) se 5, phir \(R_2\) se 5 bahar nikalein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 3 & 5 & 0 \\ 5 & 25 & 10 \\ 7 & 25 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = 25\begin{vmatrix} 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 7 & 5 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\)
Tareeqa: Property v do dafa: row ya column ka common factor determinant ke bahar aa jata hai. Is sawal mein expand karne ki zaroorat hi nahi.

Column 2 se 5 bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = 5\begin{vmatrix} 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 5 & 5 & 10 \\ 7 & 5 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(5 = 5 \cdot 1\), \(25 = 5 \cdot 5\), \(25 = 5 \cdot 5\). Is liye column 2 ki entries \(1, 5, 5\) ban gayin.

Row 2 se 5 bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = 5 \cdot 5\begin{vmatrix} 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 7 & 5 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 25\begin{vmatrix} 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 7 & 5 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Ab row 2 hai \(5, 5, 10\), jis mein 5 common hai: \(5(1, 1, 2)\). Do dafa 5 bahar aaya, yani 25, aur bacha hua determinant bilkul right side wala hai.
Dhyan dein: Ek factor ek hi line (row ya column) se nikalta hai. Pehle column se nikala, phir nayi row dekh kar doosra nikala.

Tasdeeq (dono values nikal kar)
\[\begin{vmatrix} 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 7 & 5 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = 3(1 - 10) - 1(1 - 14) + 0\]
\[= -27 + 13 = -14\]
\[\Delta = 3(25 - 250) - 5(5 - 70) + 0 = -675 + 325 = -350\]
\[25 \times (-14) = -350 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono taraf row 1 ke along expand kiya; dono ka rishta 25 guna hi nikla.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: dono taraf \(-350\) hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (ii) Show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} a+b & a & a \\ a & a+b & a \\ a & a & a+b \end{vmatrix} = b^2(3a+b)\)
blocks.explanation:
Letters wala determinant hai aur jawab \(b^2(3a+b)\) dikhana hai.
Har row ka total dekhein: \((a+b) + a + a = 3a + b\). Yeh har row mein same hai, is liye columns jama karne se common factor milega.
Plan: \(C_1 + C_2 + C_3 \to C_1\), \(3a+b\) bahar, zeros banayein, triangular determinant ki diagonal multiply karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a+b & a & a \\ a & a+b & a \\ a & a & a+b \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = b^2(3a+b)\)
Tareeqa: Property vii (columns jama), Property v (factor bahar), Property viii (triangular determinant = diagonal entries ka product). Jawab mein \((3a + b)\) ka factor khud ishara de raha hai ke yeh row total hai.

Teeno columns ko column 1 mein jama karein
\[C_1 + C_2 + C_3 \to C_1\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 3a+b & a & a \\ 3a+b & a+b & a \\ 3a+b & a & a+b \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Har row ka total \(3a + b\) hai. Property vii se value nahi badli.

Column 1 se \(3a+b\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = (3a+b)\begin{vmatrix} 1 & a & a \\ 1 & a+b & a \\ 1 & a & a+b \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property v. Ab column 1 mein sirf 1 hain, jo zeros banane ke liye behtareen hain.

Row 1 ko row 2 aur 3 mein se minus karein
\[R_2 - R_1 \to R_2,\quad R_3 - R_1 \to R_3\]
\[\Delta = (3a+b)\begin{vmatrix} 1 & a & a \\ 0 & b & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & b \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \((a+b) - a = b\) aur \(a - a = 0\). Ab diagonal ke neeche sab zero hain; yeh upper triangular shakal hai.

Diagonal multiply karein
\[\Delta = (3a+b)(1 \cdot b \cdot b)\]
\[= b^2(3a+b)\]
Kyun: Property viii: triangular determinant ki value diagonal entries ka product hoti hai. Chahein to column 1 ke along expand kar ke bhi \(1(b \cdot b - 0) = b^2\) milta hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (iii) Show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & x & yz \\ 1 & y & zx \\ 1 & z & xy \end{vmatrix} = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & x & x^2 \\ 1 & y & y^2 \\ 1 & z & z^2 \end{vmatrix}\)
blocks.explanation:
Do letters wale determinants ki barabari dikhani hai.
Right side mein \(x^2\) hai aur left mein \(yz\). Row 1 ko \(x\) se multiply karein to \(x \to x^2\) aur \(yz \to xyz\) ban jata hai; row 2 ko \(y\) aur row 3 ko \(z\) se karein to bhi yahi hota hai.
Plan: rows ko \(x, y, z\) se multiply, \(C_3\) se \(xyz\) bahar, phir \(C_3\) ko aage le aayein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & x & yz \\ 1 & y & zx \\ 1 & z & xy \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & x & x^2 \\ 1 & y & y^2 \\ 1 & z & z^2 \end{vmatrix}\)
Tareeqa: Property v (rows multiply karna aur factor bahar nikalna) aur Property ii (do columns ka interchange sign badal deta hai). Hum \(x, y, z \neq 0\) maante hain kyunke un se multiply/divide karna hai.

\(R_1\) ko \(x\), \(R_2\) ko \(y\), \(R_3\) ko \(z\) se multiply karein
\[\Delta = \dfrac{1}{xyz}\begin{vmatrix} x & x^2 & xyz \\ y & y^2 & xyz \\ z & z^2 & xyz \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(yz \cdot x = xyz\), \(zx \cdot y = xyz\), \(xy \cdot z = xyz\). Value \(xyz\) guna hui, is liye barabari ke liye bahar \(\frac{1}{xyz}\).

Column 3 se \(xyz\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} x & x^2 & 1 \\ y & y^2 & 1 \\ z & z^2 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property v; \(\frac{xyz}{xyz} = 1\). Ab sab cheezein right side wali hain, bas column ki tarteeb alag hai.

Column 3 ko aage le aayein
\[C_3 \leftrightarrow C_2:\ \ -\begin{vmatrix} x & 1 & x^2 \\ y & 1 & y^2 \\ z & 1 & z^2 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[C_2 \leftrightarrow C_1:\ \ +\begin{vmatrix} 1 & x & x^2 \\ 1 & y & y^2 \\ 1 & z & z^2 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property ii: har interchange par sign badalta hai. Do interchange hue, to sign do dafa badal kar wapas plus ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: Agar aap \(C_1\) aur \(C_3\) ko seedha badal dein to \(1, x^2, x\) wali ghalat tarteeb banti hai; columns ko ek ek qadam aage peeche karein aur har qadam par sign ginein.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & x & x^2 \\ 1 & y & y^2 \\ 1 & z & z^2 \end{vmatrix}\)

blocks.prompt: 3 (iv) Show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} m+n & l & l \\ m & n+l & m \\ n & n & l+m \end{vmatrix} = 4lmn\)
blocks.explanation:
Jawab \(4lmn\) dikhana hai.
Ghaur karein: column 1 mein \(m + n,\ m,\ n\) hain. Row 1 mein se row 2 aur row 3 minus karein to pehli entry zero ho jayegi aur baaqi entries bhi simple ban jayengi.
Plan: \(R_1 - R_2 - R_3 \to R_1\), phir row 1 ke along expand.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} m+n & l & l \\ m & n+l & m \\ n & n & l+m \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = 4lmn\)
Tareeqa: Property vii se ek zero banana, phir expansion. Zero wali row ke along expand karne se ek term khatam ho jati hai.

Row 1 mein se row 2 aur row 3 minus karein
\[R_1 - R_2 - R_3 \to R_1\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 0 & -2n & -2m \\ m & n+l & m \\ n & n & l+m \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Column 1: \((m+n) - m - n = 0\); column 2: \(l - (n+l) - n = -2n\); column 3: \(l - m - (l+m) = -2m\). Property vii se value wohi.
Dhyan dein: Bracket ke saath minus ho to andar ke sab signs badalte hain: \(-(n+l) = -n - l\).

Row 1 ke along expand karein
\[\Delta = 0 - (-2n)\begin{vmatrix} m & m \\ n & l+m \end{vmatrix} + (-2m)\begin{vmatrix} m & n+l \\ n & n \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Signs \(+,\,-,\,+\). Pehli entry zero hai, us ki term khatam.

Dono minors nikalein
\[\begin{vmatrix} m & m \\ n & l+m \end{vmatrix} = ml + m^2 - mn\]
\[\begin{vmatrix} m & n+l \\ n & n \end{vmatrix} = mn - n^2 - nl\]
Kyun: \(2 \times 2\) rule: \(m(l+m) - m \cdot n\) aur \(m \cdot n - n(n+l)\).

Multiply kar ke simplify karein
\[\Delta = 2n(ml + m^2 - mn) - 2m(mn - n^2 - nl)\]
\[= 2lmn + 2m^2n - 2mn^2 - 2m^2n + 2mn^2 + 2lmn\]
\[= 4lmn\]
Kyun: \(-(-2n) = +2n\). Phir \(2m^2n\) aur \(-2m^2n\), \(-2mn^2\) aur \(+2mn^2\) jore bana kar cancel ho gaye; sirf \(2lmn + 2lmn\) bacha.

Tasdeeq (numbers rakh kar)
\[l = m = n = 1:\ \begin{vmatrix} 2 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = 4\]
\[4lmn = 4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Yeh wohi determinant hai jo Sawal 1(vi) mein aaya tha, aur us ki value 4 thi.

blocks.prompt: 3 (v) Show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} y & -1 & x \\ x & y & 0 \\ 1 & x & y \end{vmatrix} = x^3 + y^3\)
blocks.explanation:
Jawab \(x^3 + y^3\) dikhana hai.
Yeh chhota sa determinant hai; expansion seedha aur chhota hai, is liye properties ki zaroorat nahi.
Plan: row 1 ke along expand karein aur simplify.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} y & -1 & x \\ x & y & 0 \\ 1 & x & y \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = x^3 + y^3\)
Tareeqa: Row 1 ke along expansion, signs \(+,\,-,\,+\). Middle entry khud \(-1\) hai, is liye do minus mil kar plus banenge.

Row 1 ke along expand karein
\[\Delta = y\begin{vmatrix} y & 0 \\ x & y \end{vmatrix} - (-1)\begin{vmatrix} x & 0 \\ 1 & y \end{vmatrix} + x\begin{vmatrix} x & y \\ 1 & x \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Har entry ko us ke signed minor se multiply kiya.

Minors nikal kar simplify karein
\[= y(y^2 - 0) + 1(xy - 0) + x(x^2 - y)\]
\[= y^3 + xy + x^3 - xy\]
\[= x^3 + y^3\]
Kyun: Har \(2 \times 2\) mein diagonal product minus doosra diagonal. \(+xy\) aur \(-xy\) cancel ho gaye.

Tasdeeq (numbers rakh kar)
\[x = 1,\ y = 2:\ \begin{vmatrix} 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = 8 + 2 - 1 = 9\]
\[x^3 + y^3 = 1 + 8 = 9 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Row 1 expansion: \(2(4 - 0) + 1(2 - 0) + 1(1 - 2) = 9\). Dono barabar.

blocks.explanation:
Jawab \(r\) dikhana hai; is mein trigonometry bhi hai.
Row 2 dekhein: \(0, 1, 0\). Sirf ek entry non-zero hai, to usi row ke along expand karna sab se tez hai.
Plan: row 2 ke along expand, phir \(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} r\cos\theta & 1 & -\sin\theta \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ r\sin\theta & 0 & \cos\theta \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = r\)
Tareeqa: Sab se zyada zero wali row (row 2) ke along expansion. Row 2 ke signs \(-,\,+,\,-\) hain.

Row 2 ke along expand karein
\[\Delta = (+1)\begin{vmatrix} r\cos\theta & -\sin\theta \\ r\sin\theta & \cos\theta \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Zero entries kuch nahi deti. 1 position \((2,2)\) par hai, sign \((-1)^{2+2} = +\). Minor ke liye row 2 aur column 2 chhupaya.

Minor nikalein
\[= r\cos^2\theta - (-\sin\theta)(r\sin\theta)\]
\[= r\cos^2\theta + r\sin^2\theta\]
\[= r(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta) = r\]
Kyun: \(2 \times 2\) rule, phir \(r\) common, aur mashhoor identity \(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1\).

blocks.prompt: 3 (vii) Show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} a & b & c \\ b+c & c+a & a+b \\ a+b & b+c & c+a \end{vmatrix} = a^3 + b^3 + c^3 - 3abc\)
blocks.explanation:
Jawab \(a^3 + b^3 + c^3 - 3abc\) dikhana hai. Yeh expression \((a+b+c)\) ka factor rakhti hai, is liye pehle yahi factor nikalne ki koshish karenge.
Row 1 ko row 2 mein jama karein to row 2 ki har entry \(a + b + c\) ban jati hai.
Plan: \(R_2 + R_1 \to R_2\), factor bahar, row 2 mein zeros, expand, aur identity lagayein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a & b & c \\ b+c & c+a & a+b \\ a+b & b+c & c+a \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = a^3 + b^3 + c^3 - 3abc\)
Tareeqa: Property vii aur v, phir expansion, aur aakhir mein identity \(a^3 + b^3 + c^3 - 3abc = (a+b+c)(a^2+b^2+c^2-ab-bc-ca)\).

Row 1 ko row 2 mein jama karein
\[R_2 + R_1 \to R_2\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a & b & c \\ a+b+c & a+b+c & a+b+c \\ a+b & b+c & c+a \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \((b+c) + a\), \((c+a) + b\), \((a+b) + c\) teeno \(a + b + c\) hain. Property vii.

Row 2 se \(a+b+c\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = (a+b+c)\begin{vmatrix} a & b & c \\ 1 & 1 & 1 \\ a+b & b+c & c+a \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property v.

Row 2 mein zeros banayein
\[C_2 - C_1 \to C_2,\quad C_3 - C_1 \to C_3\]
\[\Delta = (a+b+c)\begin{vmatrix} a & b-a & c-a \\ 1 & 0 & 0 \\ a+b & c-a & c-b \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Row 2 mein \(1 - 1 = 0\). Row 3: \((b+c) - (a+b) = c - a\), \((c+a) - (a+b) = c - b\).

Row 2 ke along expand karein
\[\Delta = (a+b+c)(-1)\begin{vmatrix} b-a & c-a \\ c-a & c-b \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (a+b+c)\,[(c-a)^2 - (b-a)(c-b)]\]
Kyun: 1 position \((2,1)\) par hai, sign minus. Minus lagne se \(2 \times 2\) ka farq ulat jata hai: \(-(PQ - RS) = RS - PQ\).

Bracket simplify karein
\[(c-a)^2 = c^2 - 2ca + a^2\]
\[(b-a)(c-b) = bc - b^2 - ac + ab\]
\[\text{bracket} = a^2 + b^2 + c^2 - ab - bc - ca\]
Kyun: Doosra product minus ho raha hai, to us ke sab signs badle: \(-bc + b^2 + ac - ab\). Phir \(-2ca + ac = -ca\).
Dhyan dein: Lambi expressions mein ek ek term ko tick karte jayein taake koi term choot na jaye.

Identity lagayein
\[\Delta = (a+b+c)(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 - ab - bc - ca)\]
\[= a^3 + b^3 + c^3 - 3abc\]
Kyun: Yeh mashhoor identity hai: multiply karein to \(a^2b\) jaise mixed terms cancel ho jate hain aur \(-abc\) teen dafa aata hai.

Tasdeeq (numbers rakh kar)
\[a = 1,\ b = 2,\ c = 0:\ \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 3 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = -5 + 14 = 9\]
\[1 + 8 + 0 - 0 = 9 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Row 1 expansion: \(1(1 - 6) - 2(2 - 9) + 0 = 9\). Dono taraf 9.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(\Delta = a^3 + b^3 + c^3 - 3abc\)

blocks.prompt: 3 (viii) Show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} a+\lambda & a & a \\ b & b+\lambda & b \\ c & c & c+\lambda \end{vmatrix} = \lambda^2(a+b+c+\lambda)\)
blocks.explanation:
Jawab \(\lambda^2(a+b+c+\lambda)\) dikhana hai.
Har column ka total dekhein: column 1 mein \((a + \lambda) + b + c\). Teeno columns ka total \(a + b + c + \lambda\) hai, is liye rows jama karenge.
Plan: \(R_1 + R_2 + R_3 \to R_1\), factor bahar, row 1 mein zeros, triangular shakal.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a+\lambda & a & a \\ b & b+\lambda & b \\ c & c & c+\lambda \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = \lambda^2(a+b+c+\lambda)\)
Tareeqa: Property vii (rows jama), Property v (factor bahar), Property viii (triangular). Yeh 3(ii) jaisa hi hai, bas wahan rows ka total same tha aur yahan columns ka.

Teeno rows ko row 1 mein jama karein
\[R_1 + R_2 + R_3 \to R_1\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} s & s & s \\ b & b+\lambda & b \\ c & c & c+\lambda \end{vmatrix}\]
\[s = a + b + c + \lambda\]
Kyun: Har column mein \(a, b, c\) ek ek dafa aur \(\lambda\) ek dafa hai, is liye har total \(s\) hai. Lambi likhai bachane ke liye \(s\) likha.

Row 1 se \(s\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = s\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ b & b+\lambda & b \\ c & c & c+\lambda \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property v.

Row 1 mein zeros banayein
\[C_2 - C_1 \to C_2,\quad C_3 - C_1 \to C_3\]
\[\Delta = s\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ b & \lambda & 0 \\ c & 0 & \lambda \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \((b+\lambda) - b = \lambda\), \(b - b = 0\), \(c - c = 0\), \((c+\lambda) - c = \lambda\). Ab diagonal ke upar sab zero: lower triangular.

Diagonal multiply karein
\[\Delta = s(1 \cdot \lambda \cdot \lambda)\]
\[= \lambda^2(a + b + c + \lambda)\]
Kyun: Property viii: triangular determinant = diagonal ka product.

blocks.prompt: 3 (ix) Show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & x & x^2 \\ 1 & y & y^2 \\ 1 & z & z^2 \end{vmatrix} = (x-y)(y-z)(z-x)\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh mashhoor determinant hai (Vandermonde determinant); dikhana hai ke yeh \((x-y)(y-z)(z-x)\) ke barabar hai.
Column 1 mein sab 1 hain, is liye rows minus karne se foran zeros bante hain.
Plan: \(R_2 - R_1\), \(R_3 - R_1\), phir \((y-x)\) aur \((z-x)\) bahar, phir expand.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & x & x^2 \\ 1 & y & y^2 \\ 1 & z & z^2 \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = (x-y)(y-z)(z-x)\)
Tareeqa: Property vii, difference of squares \(y^2 - x^2 = (y-x)(y+x)\), aur Property v.

Row 1 ko row 2 aur 3 mein se minus karein
\[R_2 - R_1 \to R_2,\quad R_3 - R_1 \to R_3\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & x & x^2 \\ 0 & y-x & y^2-x^2 \\ 0 & z-x & z^2-x^2 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property vii se value nahi badli, aur column 1 mein do zero ban gaye.

\(R_2\) se \((y-x)\) aur \(R_3\) se \((z-x)\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = (y-x)(z-x)\begin{vmatrix} 1 & x & x^2 \\ 0 & 1 & y+x \\ 0 & 1 & z+x \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(y^2 - x^2 = (y-x)(y+x)\) aur \(z^2 - x^2 = (z-x)(z+x)\); is liye har row mein ek common bracket mil gaya.

Column 1 ke along expand karein
\[\Delta = (y-x)(z-x)[(z+x) - (y+x)]\]
\[= (y-x)(z-x)(z-y)\]
Kyun: Sirf top wala 1 bacha; us ka minor \(1(z+x) - 1(y+x) = z - y\).

Factors ko tarteeb dein
\[(y-x)(z-y) = (x-y)(y-z)\]
\[\Delta = (x-y)(y-z)(z-x)\]
Kyun: \(y - x = -(x - y)\) aur \(z - y = -(y - z)\). Do minus mil kar plus, is liye jawab book wali shakal mein aa gaya.
Dhyan dein: Bracket ko ulatne par sign badalta hai; har ulte bracket par ek minus ginein.

blocks.prompt: 3 (x) Show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} y+z & z+x & x+y \\ x & y & z \\ x^2 & y^2 & z^2 \end{vmatrix} = (x+y+z)(x-y)(y-z)(z-x)\)
blocks.explanation:
Jawab \((x+y+z)(x-y)(y-z)(z-x)\) dikhana hai: yani part (ix) wala jawab, \((x+y+z)\) guna.
Row 2 ko row 1 mein jama karein to row 1 ki har entry \(x + y + z\) ban jati hai.
Plan: \(R_1 + R_2 \to R_1\), factor bahar, phir part (ix) wala tareeqa columns par.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} y+z & z+x & x+y \\ x & y & z \\ x^2 & y^2 & z^2 \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = (x+y+z)(x-y)(y-z)(z-x)\)
Tareeqa: Property vii aur v, phir part (ix) jaisa kaam. Pichla sawal agle sawal ki chaabi hai.

Row 2 ko row 1 mein jama karein
\[R_1 + R_2 \to R_1\]
\[\Delta = (x+y+z)\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ x & y & z \\ x^2 & y^2 & z^2 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \((y+z) + x\), \((z+x) + y\), \((x+y) + z\) teeno \(x + y + z\) hain; Property v se yeh factor row 1 se bahar aa gaya.

Column 1 ko column 2 aur 3 mein se minus karein
\[C_2 - C_1 \to C_2,\quad C_3 - C_1 \to C_3\]
\[\Delta = (x+y+z)\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ x & y-x & z-x \\ x^2 & y^2-x^2 & z^2-x^2 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property vii; row 1 mein do zero ban gaye.

\(C_2\) se \((y-x)\) aur \(C_3\) se \((z-x)\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = (x+y+z)(y-x)(z-x)\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ x & 1 & 1 \\ x^2 & y+x & z+x \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Row 3 mein difference of squares, phir Property v.

Row 1 ke along expand karein
\[\Delta = (x+y+z)(y-x)(z-x)[(z+x) - (y+x)]\]
\[= (x+y+z)(y-x)(z-x)(z-y)\]
\[= (x+y+z)(x-y)(y-z)(z-x)\]
Kyun: Sirf \((1,1)\) wala 1 bacha. Aakhir mein part (ix) ki tarah do brackets ulte, do minus mil kar plus.
